scenario: [LCAP.2.1.5] / [LDIA.3.2.3]: the `realtime` dialect is refused at its name whatever its block overrides. The block sets both deferred capabilities `false`, which leaves `default`'s settings, so a compiler that refuses only on the resolved settings compiles this program and reports compile_ok instead. PATH PINNED: dialect-name resolution in `dsc.dialect`, which runs before override resolution.
rules_ds:
use realtime:
    realtime: false
    constspace: false

schema Sensor scope logical:
    entity_id: String key
    v: Int mutable

rule r:
    Sensor
->
    log info "x"
